text: すき　すぎて　こわい　ことって　あるの

patterns.name: 〜すぎる
patterns.explanation: すぎる on a word means 'too much'. In the て form it gives the reason for what comes next. すき すぎて こわい = 'I love him so much that it's scary'.

patterns.name: 〜こともある
patterns.span: こわい　ことって　あるの
patterns.explanation: こと with ある says something happens sometimes. Here casual って stands where が or も would be. こわい ことって ある = 'there are times it scares me'.

patterns.name: 〜の (sentence end)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a statement gives a soft explaining tone, mostly used by women and children. あるの = 'there are, you know'.
